armyRules.name: Prioritised Efficiency
armyRules.effect: LEAGUES OF VOTANN units have Hostile Acquisition (re-roll Advance/Charge; +1 Hit near objectives) or Fortify Takeover (+1 Hit while holding an objective; -1 Wound vs high-Strength attacks) depending on Yield Points (YP). Start of battle: Hostile Acquisition. End of Command phase: fewer than 7YP = Hostile Acquisition; 7YP+ = Fortify Takeover. Gain YP for holding objectives each Command phase, more for additional objective-control conditions from round 2 onward.

battleFormations.effect: Assailed From Every Angle: Guerrilla Adepts ability — units can restrict their shooting to one enemy unit to mark it 'assailed' (and 'pinned' with -2" Move/-2 Charge if already assailed) until your next Shooting phase.

artefacts.name: Oathbound Speculator
artefacts.effect: [LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only] Re-roll Wound rolls of 1; spend 3YP for +1 Wound roll for the unit that phase.

artefacts.name: Dead Reckoning
artefacts.effect: [LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only] At the end of a turn with no YP spent, gain 1YP.

artefacts.name: Iron Ambassador
artefacts.effect: [LEAGUES OF VOTANN model with Autoch-pattern combi-bolter only] Once per battle, spend up to 3YP to add that much Damage to the bearer's ranged weapons that phase.

artefacts.name: Ancestral Crest
artefacts.effect: [LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only] Once per turn, spend 1YP to reduce the Command Re-roll Stratagem's cost by 1CP.

artefacts.name: Eye for Weakness

artefacts.name: Writ of Acquisition

artefacts.name: Surgical Saboteur
artefacts.effect: [LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only] A Monster/Vehicle unit hit while shooting becomes pinned until your next Shooting phase.

artefacts.name: Nomad Strategist
